turns.doctor_question: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. Thank you for coming in today. What brings you to the clinic?
turns.patient_response:
Hello. Well... I suppose I came in because I just can't seem to get anything in order anymore. 

It's... my kitchen table is just covered with things. My husband’s appointment papers, church flyers, notes from the senior center... half-finished lists. I just sit there looking at it all. I don't know which thing to do first, and... then the whole day is just gone.

turns.doctor_question: How long have you been experiencing this difficulty with organizing and getting things done?
turns.patient_response: Well... I suppose it's been this much of a problem for... about a year and three months. Give or take. It really started piling up when my husband began needing regular help with his appointments... and his daily arrangements. Just... since then, mostly.
